issues.description: Inconsistent return type for Lecture.getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): the problem statement UML specifies an int return type, but the template hint explicitly states the return type should be double and the reference solution implements the method as returning double. This can confuse students and may cause signature-based grading/tests to fail depending on what the tests expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method contract consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) update the UML/problem statement to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double, or (B) change the template hint and solution implementation/signature to return int (e.g., integer division or defined rounding) to match the UML.
